text:
Situation: Sodium chloride is on FDA's shortage list as To Be Discontinued, first posted 2018-06-21. Corvale Lakeside holds 117 units of 9 mg/mL, 50 mL with 16.7 days on hand. Corvale East holds 349 units with 9.2 days on hand. Other Corvale sites hold multiple sodium chloride presentations with 8.9 to 16.1 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list shows sodium chloride as To Be Discontinued since 2018-06-21. An FDA inspection of Hospira, Inc. (FEI 1925262) ended 2016-06-08, classified OAI, 743 days before the posting. A Warning Letter was issued to Hospira, Inc. (FEI 1925262) on 2017-02-14, 492 days before the posting. Another FDA inspection of Hospira, Inc. (FEI 1925262) ended 2018-08-15, classified OAI, 55 days after the posting. An FDA inspection of Pfizer Healthcare India Private Limited (FEI 3008316085) ended 2019-09-06, classified OAI, 442 days after the posting.

Our position: Internal stock is limited at Corvale East for the 9 mg/mL, 50 mL presentation. Corvale Lakeside can spare units while retaining two weeks of supply. Alternative manufacturers are not on FDA's shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 18 units of 9 mg/mL, 50 mL from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director approval for transfer request.
2. Evaluate purchase from Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. — needs buyer approval.
3. Evaluate purchase from Medefil, Inc. — needs buyer approval.
4. Evaluate purchase from Becton Dickinson and Company — needs buyer approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary substitutions at this time; those are for treating clinicians and the committee.
